title: Culturally-Grounded Governance for Multilingual Language Models: Rights, Data Boundaries, and Accountable AI Design
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable as the paper does not analyze aspects of religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention religion, faith, or specific religious groups. Its focus is on the cultural, linguistic, and sociotechnical challenges of multilingual large language models, particularly concerning low-resource languages and marginalized communities.
